heading.title: Of the Powers of an Executor or Administrator

article.title: Powers of administrator of effects unadministered.
article.content:
313Powers of administrator of effects unadministered.

Section 313  ·  Part IX · Chapter VI  ·  page 84 of the Act
The administrator of effects unadministered has, with respect to such effects, the same powers as the original executor or administrator.
